item.text:
The draft conflicts with your explicit goal: **rebuild trust so you can discuss a small supply trial**. Your history says Lea dislikes aggressive asks, worries about price and reliable supply, and the previous pursuit was lost after inconsistent delivery. A new deal does not erase those concerns. The stock-shortage claim is unsupported.

Suggested email:

> **Subject: Addressing your supply concerns**
>
> Hi Lea,
>
> Your concerns about price and reliable supply still matter, especially after the inconsistent delivery last time.
>
> Did the supply reliability summary I promised reach you? I’d like us to review that and pricing before discussing a small trial.
>
> Would a brief conversation tomorrow, 1 October, suit you? If so, what time works best?
>
> Best,  
> Ilya

Once a time is agreed, use this invitation wording:

> **Linden Pharmacy — supply reliability and pricing**
>
> Review the supply reliability summary, discuss pricing concerns, and consider whether a small trial makes sense.

I retrieved the account history, retained your draft, and saved the critique and recommendation. CRM is not configured, so I made no CRM changes. I sent no email and created no invitation: the supplied sales executive coach instructions prohibit those external actions.
